insights.claim: You ship with AI almost every working day
Claude Code carries half your sessions
Late mornings are your deepest AI hours
Two cost spikes drove a fifth of spend
Fewer than four in ten sessions end in a commit
Cursor to Claude Code is your busiest handoff
Antigravity prompts need rewording 1.7x more often
Bugfix sessions hit the most friction
Naming files lifts success by about 16 points
Short vague prompts cost you retries
Four small habits would remove most friction
